sampleArticles.title: Zelensky rejects Trump proposal to cede territory to Russia
sampleArticles.description: President Donald Trump, who is due to meet President Vladimir Putin in Alaska on Friday, suggested Ukraine and Russia swap some territory to achieve peace.
